bio.text: Zach Nunn represents Iowa's 3rd Congressional District in the U.S. House and serves on the Financial Services and Agriculture committees.
Before Congress he served in the Iowa House and Iowa Senate.

He served almost two decades in the U.S. Air Force as an intelligence officer, is a Colonel in the Air Force Reserve, and attended Drake University, the Air Command and Staff College and the University of Cambridge.
He is a sixth-generation Iowan and lives in Ankeny.
